sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Fight Nikare and Kenut together, then split into two groups at 50% to burn each one down separately. Platform submerges in 2 minutes once that phase starts.

sections.heading: Split phase (50% → 25%)
bullets: The squad divides onto Nikare's and Kenut's platforms and fights both simultaneously — each side can advance once their target hits 25%.
DPS the twins down evenly — an enraged twin (from being left too far behind) is dangerous, especially Nikare, whose Vapor Rush dash can one-shot most players.
Communicate defiance bar breaks across both groups, not just your own platform.

sections.heading: Kenut's platform hazards
bullets: Three water tornadoes rotate clockwise around the arena — the tank should hold the boss center and step out (or channel a block) when a tornado sweeps through.
Aquatic Barrage spins up defiance bars that must be broken quickly to stop incoming water bolts — use projectile destruction where you have it.

sections.heading: Waterlogged
bullets: Stacks build from water hazards and attacks — 10 stacks is instant death. Keep condition cleanses up and avoid unnecessary water exposure.
